properties.description: An rts 1v1 battle game, the background is the sandbox simulation of modern military warfare. You can command the coordinated operations of sea, land, air and space, play tactics freely, and experience military art, to fight until the enemy's capital is destroyed to win.\r\n
properties.short_description: In a modern military sandbox, players command forces across multiple domains to destroy the enemy's capital and achieve victory.

short_descriptions.value: In einem modernen militärischen Sandbox-Spiel befehligen Spieler Kräfte in mehreren Bereichen, um die feindliche Hauptstadt zu zerstören und zu siegen.
En un sandbox militar moderno, los jugadores dirigen fuerzas en varios dominios para destruir la capital enemiga y lograr la victoria.

results.name: Air Traffic Sim: Airport Dispatch Simulator
Air Traffic Sim: Airport Dispatcher Simulator

properties.description:
Welcome to airport controller simulator! Airport administrator, build a route for the flight of the airplane in such a way as to avoid all dangers and land the airplane on the airfield!

You are an airport controller and your task is to draw the correct route and land the plane safely on airfields.

It sounds simple, but various obstacles will interfere with you - bad weather conditions, other participants in the airspace and the landscape. Try to build a route so that during the flight the plane avoids collisions and successfully lands.

Many different levels will not let you get bored, and difficult obstacles will force you to strain your attention and logic to the limit!
properties.short_description: As an airport controller, navigate planes safely through obstacles to ensure successful landings on various challenging levels.

short_descriptions.value: Als Flughafenlotse navigierst du Flugzeuge sicher durch Hindernisse, um erfolgreiche Landungen auf verschiedenen herausfordernden Levels zu gewährleisten.
Como controlador aeroportuario, guía aviones con seguridad a través de obstáculos para lograr aterrizajes exitosos en niveles desafiantes.
En tant que contrôleur aéroportuaire, guidez les avions en toute sécurité à travers des obstacles pour assurer des atterrissages réussis sur divers niveaux difficiles.
As an airport controller, navigate planes safely through obstacles to ensure successful landings on various challenging levels.

properties.description: 911 Dispatcher is a story-driven, text-based PC game about the challenging and difficult work of an emergency line operator. Your decisions will determine the fate of the people on the other end of the line; a single mistake can cost someone's life. No pressure.
properties.short_description: Players assume the role of an emergency line operator, making critical decisions that impact the lives of callers in urgent situations.

short_descriptions.value: Die Spieler übernehmen die Rolle eines Notrufdisponenten und treffen entscheidende Entscheidungen, die das Leben der Anrufer in dringenden Situationen beeinflussen.
Los jugadores asumen el papel de operador de emergencias, tomando decisiones críticas que afectan la vida de los llamantes en situaciones urgentes.
Les joueurs incarnent un opérateur d'urgence, prenant des décisions cruciales qui impactent la vie des appelants en situations urgentes.
Players assume the role of an emergency line operator, making critical decisions that impact the lives of callers in urgent situations.
